game_capture_description: Launch or attach a game, then monitor text, voice, screenshots and Anki output.
game_capture_empty_body: Launch or bind a game; text and sentence-audio status will appear here.
game_capture_window_missing: The game process started but its window never appeared, so the game may not have launched. Try starting it again.
game_card_mapping_missing: Anki field mappings are missing game-card tokens
game_card_sentence_audio_missing: The card was created without sentence audio; no other line's audio was substituted.

game_diagnostics_subtitle: Session stages, endpoints, audio tracks and structured events
game_drop_no_exe: No new game .exe among the dropped files
game_edit_launch_args_hint: Passed to the game on launch, e.g. -windowed
game_endpoints_engine_active: Text is provided by the engine hook; these endpoints are optional
game_endpoints_hint: Ports for external text tools (Textractor / LunaTranslator etc.); ignore if you don't use them
game_helper_install_incomplete: Engine component install incomplete, please retry
game_helper_needed_body: Launching a galgame needs the engine-hook injector component (about $size). It contains process-injection code and ships separately from the app to avoid antivirus false positives. Download it now?
game_helper_verification_failed: Engine component blocked: its checksum could not be verified (the .sha256 file from GitHub is unreachable, missing, or does not match). Hibiki refuses to install unverified injector code.
game_hook_fallback_all_audio_sources_fai: Neither the engine voice hook nor the system loopback could be started; no audio can be captured.
game_hook_fallback_engine_attach_failed: Attaching the engine voice hook to the running game failed; system mix is used instead.
game_hook_fallback_engine_pcm_unavailabl: The engine voice hook is installed, but the game has not played any voice yet. System mix is used for now and will switch back automatically once the first voice arrives.
game_hook_fallback_launch_injection_fail: The game is running, but early engine injection failed; system mix is used instead.
game_hook_fallback_window_not_found: Audio capture is running, but the game window has not appeared yet, so screenshots are unavailable. It will bind automatically once the window shows up.
game_hook_line_unavailable: This captured line is no longer available.
game_hook_reason_access_denied: The game runs with higher privileges; start Hibiki as administrator and try again.
game_hook_reason_bitness_mismatch: Helper architecture does not match the game (32-bit vs 64-bit); reinstall the helper.
game_hook_reason_create_process_failed: The game could not be started from Hibiki; check the executable path.
game_hook_reason_elevation_required: This game requires administrator rights; start Hibiki as administrator and launch it again.
game_hook_reason_game_exe_missing: The game executable no longer exists at the saved path.
game_hook_reason_guarded_hook_failed: A profile-guarded hook could not be installed in time; retrying automatically.
game_hook_reason_handshake_timeout: The game was hooked but produced no text or audio in time; this engine may not be supported yet.
game_hook_reason_helper_missing: Voice-hook helper is not installed for this game architecture; install it and try again.
game_hook_reason_hook_dll_missing: The helper package is incomplete (hook library missing); reinstall it.
game_hook_reason_injection_failed: Injection into the game was blocked; add Hibiki and the game to antivirus exclusions.
game_hook_reason_ready_timeout: The hook library did not finish loading in time; antivirus scanning can cause this.
game_hook_reason_resume_failed: The launched game could not be resumed and was stopped; launch it again.
game_hook_reason_shared_memory_unavailab: The capture channel could not be opened; restart Hibiki.
game_hook_reason_spawn_failed: The helper could not be started; check that antivirus has not removed or blocked it.
game_hook_reason_stale_session: A previous capture session is still loaded in the game; restart the game once.
game_hook_reason_steam_timeout: Steam accepted the launch request but the game process never appeared.
game_hook_reason_target_missing: No game process or executable was selected for capture.
game_hook_recapture_empty: No audio captured in the recapture window
game_hook_recapture_saved: Recaptured voice saved to this line
game_hook_recapture_started: Recording — replay this line in the game
game_hook_recapture_unavailable: Voice recapture needs system loopback audio
game_launch_unsupported: Launching games is only supported on Windows
game_line_preview_failed: No playable audio for this line
game_line_track_applied: Voice track applied to this line
game_line_track_failed: That track has no audio around this line
game_line_track_tooltip: Pick the voice track for this line
game_no_active_line: Select a line to inspect its sentence-audio state.
game_no_match: No games match the current filters
game_summary_none: No description yet. Fetch metadata to fill it in.
game_text_gaps_hint: Sequence gaps = dropped-line count in the hook text ring; 0 is normal
game_text_thread_hint: Choose the clean dialogue thread, like Luna Translator
game_track_exclusion_hint: Mark a BGM/ambience track as excluded so auto-selection never treats it as voice — lines without speech no longer pick up BGM.
game_track_preview_failed: No recent audio could be captured from this track
game_track_select_requires_engine: Track selection requires an active engine hook session
game_tracks_loopback_hint: System loopback captures the whole system's mixed output as a single stream; per-track enumeration is not available.
game_tracks_pcm_only_hint: Per-track selection only affects capture while engine PCM is the active audio backend. The list below is read-only under the current backend.
game_tracks_resource_mode_hint: In game-resource audio mode, each voice line is extracted directly from game files, so no PCM track list exists here. Automatic or manual track selection only applies to engine PCM capture.
game_upscaling_download_body: Game window upscaling needs Magpie (about 10 MB, GPL-3.0, built by us from source). Download it now?
game_upscaling_hint_external: A copy of Magpie was already running, so Hibiki left it alone. Press Win+Shift+A to upscale the game window.
game_upscaling_hint_first_run: Magpie still had to set itself up this time. Press Win+Shift+A to upscale now — next time you start the game it will happen automatically.
game_upscaling_hint_manual: Press Win+Shift+A to upscale the game window.
game_upscaling_status_manual: Window upscaling is ready, but did not start on its own
global_context_capture_hint: Read surrounding text from the foreground app to show the current sentence (Windows only)
hover_auto_lookup_hint: Fare bir karakterin üzerine geldiğinde otomatik olarak ara; tıklamaya veya Shift tuşunu basılı tutmaya gerek yok. En fazla bir açılır katman gösterir. Yalnızca masaüstü.
icon_custom_confirm_body: Seçtiğiniz görsel ile bir ana ekran kısayolu oluşturulacak. Devam edilsin mi?
icon_custom_hint: Değiştirmek için bir simgeye dokunun veya aşağıdan özel bir görsel seçin.
image_pause_hint: Oynatma sırasında bir resim göründüğünde otomatik duraklat.
import_duplicate: 『$name』 adında bir sözlük zaten içe aktarılmış.
interconnect_backup_backend: Use interconnect as the backup backend
interconnect_backup_backend_active: Backups already go to the paired device. Pick another backend in Sync & backup to switch away.
interconnect_backup_backend_hint: Back up and sync to the paired device instead of a cloud drive. Everything the paired-device upload switches above allow is what gets written there.
interconnect_backup_backend_needs_pairin: Connect to a device above first.
interconnect_enable_hint: Connect to your other devices over the LAN. Works alongside a cloud backup backend — they don't conflict.
interconnect_moved_note: Connection & server settings are in the Hibiki Interconnect category
interconnect_summary: Direct device-to-device sync & host this device as a server
interconnect_upload_audiobook_files_hint: Sync this device's audiobook audio and subtitle packages up to the interconnect peer (large).
interconnect_upload_content_hint: Sync this device's books and reading content up to the interconnect peer.
interconnect_upload_dictionary_hint: Sync this device's dictionaries up to the interconnect peer.
interconnect_upload_section_footer: Choose what this device uploads to the connected peer. Independent from cloud backup and from the Enable interconnect toggle — off by default.
interconnect_upload_video_files_hint: Sync this device's local video files up to the interconnect peer (large).
loading_slow_message: If your data storage location is on a network or removable drive that is currently disconnected, startup can stall. Tap Retry to launch using the default storage location for this session; your data stays where it is.
loading_slow_message_mobile: Startup is taking longer than usual — Hibiki may be loading a large library or dictionaries. Please wait a moment, or tap Retry to reload. Your data is safe and won't be lost.
loading_slow_title: Startup is taking longer than usual
local_audio_invalid_db: This file isn't a usable audio database (not a Local Audio Server database, or it has no audio).
local_audio_reference_original_desc: Keep the database where it is and read from its original path; the source breaks if the file is moved or deleted.
log_upload_consent_body: Günlük metni (hata mesajları, dosya yolları ve kitap başlıkları içerebilir) ile uygulama sürümünüz, platformunuz ve cihaz modeliniz, sorunların tespitine yardımcı olmak için geliştiricinin sunucusuna yüklenir. Bu yalnızca yükle düğmesine dokunduğunuzda gerçekleşir — hiçbir şey otomatik olarak gönderilmez.
low_memory_mode_hint: Düşük donanımlı cihazlar için önbellek ve bellek kullanımını azaltır. Bazı değişiklikler yeniden başlatma gerektirir.
low_memory_mode_suggestion: Ayarlar → Çeşitli bölümünden Düşük Bellek Modunu etkinleştirmeyi deneyin.
lyrics_blur_hint: Blur the current line for listening immersion; hover or tap to reveal
lyrics_font_size_hint: Şarkı sözü yazı boyutu kitap modundan bağımsızdır
lyrics_mode_hint_body: Şarkı sözü modunun kendi yazı boyutu ayarı vardır. ⚙ Ayarlar → Tipografi bölümünden ayarlayabilirsiniz.
lyrics_text_color_hint: Şarkı sözü metni için temayı izlemek yerine özel bir renk kullan
lyrics_vertical_writing_hint: Read lyrics top-to-bottom, right-to-left (independent of book mode)
manga_ocr_delete_confirm_message: This frees disk space. You can download them again later.
manga_ocr_engine_none: No OCR engine available. Download built-in models or set the mokuro CLI path in settings.
manga_ocr_mobile_note: On mobile, the recognition model powers box scan in the manga reader.
manga_ocr_section_summary: Built-in OCR models and external mokuro CLI
manga_ocr_unsupported: Built-in manga OCR isn't available on this platform yet.
manga_ocr_wizard_has_mokuro: This folder already has a .mokuro file — use normal import instead.
manga_ocr_wizard_no_images: No images found in this folder.
manga_remote_ocr_cancelled: Remote OCR was cancelled on the host.
manga_remote_ocr_no_host: No paired host with manga OCR is reachable.
manga_remote_ocr_not_ready: The paired host's OCR models are not downloaded. Download them on the host first.
manga_remote_ocr_unsupported: The paired host does not support manga OCR.
media_source_network_missing_fields: Enter host, username, remote path, and a password or key
media_source_remove_keeps_media: Removing a source does not delete imported media.
media_tracking_access_token_hint: Create a personal access token with write permission
media_tracking_no_mappings: No manual mappings yet. Hibiki matches automatically on the first completed episode or reading progress; add ambiguous items here.
media_tracking_summary: Automatically record anime, novel, and manga progress to Bangumi
media_tracking_sync_failed: Sync failed. The update remains queued.
media_tracking_token_required: Enter and verify an access token first
mining_audio_quality_hint: Higher bitrate is clearer but makes larger cards.
mining_image_quality_hint: Higher is sharper but makes larger cards. Maximum keeps screenshots at the source resolution; animated GIFs stay capped so cards remain usable.
name: Ad
no_collections: Yer imi veya kaydedilmiş cümle yok
overlay_lookup_independent_size_hint: Give the app-external pop-out lookup window its own max size instead of following the in-app popup
pdf_no_text_layer: This PDF has no text layer (scanned image), so lookup is unavailable.
popup_auto_expand_dictionaries_hint: Keep the first N rows of dictionary blocks expanded even when 'Collapse dictionaries' is on. The expanded count follows the column setting: rows x columns (0 = collapse all)
popup_bottom_docked_hint: Arama açılır penceresini, aranan sözcüğü izlemek yerine ekranın altında tam genişlikte bir panel olarak sabitle.
popup_dictionary_max_columns_hint: Auto-fills up to this many dictionary columns per row; narrower screens use fewer
popup_instant_scroll_hint: E-mürekkep ekranlar için arama açılır penceresini animasyonlu kaydırma olmadan sabit mesafelerle atlat.
popup_wheel_speed_hint: Mouse-wheel scroll speed for the dictionary popup (also applies to the browser extension).
reader_content_timeout: İçerik yüklemesi zaman aşımına uğradı. Görüntü anormalse yeniden açın
rematch_adjust_window: Arama penceresini ayarla ve yeniden eşleştir
remote_dict_lookup_hint: Yerel sözlükler bulamadığında, yapılandırılmış Hibiki sunucusunu sorgula
remote_video_list_failed: Couldn't load remote videos. Make sure the other device is online and on the same network, then try again.
render_restart_required: Takes effect after restarting the app
reverse_arrow_page_turn: Klavye sol/sağ sayfa çevirme yönünü tersine çevir
sasayaki_all_zero: Tüm pencereler %0 skorladı, lütfen manuel ayarlayın
sasayaki_no_sections: ttu bölüm metni bulunamadı, otomatik eşleştirme yapılamaz
sasayaki_threshold_hint: Bulanık eşleştirme için minimum benzerlik (Dice katsayısı). Daha fazla metin farkını tolere etmek için düşürün, ancak çok düşük yanlış eşleşmelere neden olur.
sasayaki_window_hint: Metinde referans başına ileri aranacak karakter sayısı. İsabet oranı düşükse ayarlayın; çok büyük değer kısa ve gürültülü referanslarda imleci kaydırabilir.
scan_non_japanese_text_hint: When off, selection stops at non-Japanese characters
shortcut_conflict_replace_confirm: Bu kısayol zaten $s tarafından kullanılıyor. Bu işleme taşınsın mı?
shortcut_gamepad_unavailable_hint: GameInput component not detected — gamepad support is unavailable. Install the Windows Gaming Services to enable controller support.
shortcut_press_wheel: Hold a modifier key and scroll here
shortcut_reset_confirm: Bu bölümdeki tüm kısayollar varsayılanlara sıfırlansın mı?
shortcut_scope_dictionary_popup_note: Works while the pointer is over a dictionary popup
shortcut_scope_global_external_mobile_no: Triggered by the system (text selection menu, share, floating ball); the OS does not allow apps to remap this hotkey.
shortcut_wheel_needs_modifier: A bare wheel scrolls the popup — hold Alt / Ctrl / Shift while scrolling
srt_audio_unresolved: Ses dosyası bulunamadı — lütfen yeniden bağlayın
srt_delete_confirm: 『$title』 silinsin mi? Bu işlem geri alınamaz.
srt_epub_not_ready: Kitap hazır değil — lütfen yeniden içe aktarın
srt_import_audio_needs_subtitle: Ses, altyazılarla eşleştirilmelidir. Mevcut bir EPUB'a ses eklemek için rafta kitaba uzun basın.
srt_import_hint_epub_or_srt: İçe aktarmak için bir EPUB veya altyazı dosyası seçin.
srt_import_missing_input: Lütfen en az bir EPUB veya altyazı dosyası seçin
startup_default_dictionary_tab_hint: Ana ekranı mevcut varsayılan yerine arama sekmesinde başlat.
stat_clear_all_reading_message: Clear all reading time, character counts, and lookup/mining counts? Your saved words, sentences, and mined cards are kept. This cannot be undone.
stat_clear_all_video_message: Clear all watch time, subtitle character counts, and lookup/mining counts? Your saved words, sentences, and mined cards are kept. This cannot be undone.
stat_delete_message: Delete this item's time, character count, and lookup/mining statistics? Your saved words and sentences are not affected.
storage_permissions: AnkiDroid'a dışa aktarma için lütfen aşağıdaki izinleri verin.
sync_compare_delete_confirm: "$name" uzaktan silinsin mi? Yerel veriler korunur. Bu geri alınamaz.
sync_compare_no_content: Yalnızca bulut verisi — indirilecek kitap yok
sync_content_warning: Büyük dosyalar depolama alanı ve veri kullanır
sync_dictionary_warning: Sözlük paketleri büyük olabilir ve içe aktarılan sözlük kaynaklarını içerebilir.
sync_err_auth_expired: Oturum süresi doldu — lütfen tekrar oturum açın.
sync_err_invalid_client: Bu yapı için istemci kimlik bilgileri geçersiz — lütfen uygulamayı güncelleyin.
sync_err_network: Sunucuya ulaşılamıyor — ağ veya proxy ayarlarınızı kontrol edin.
sync_err_not_configured: Bu yapıda Google eşitleme kimlik bilgileri yapılandırılmamış.
sync_err_scope_upgrade: Sync permissions changed — please sign in to Google again to continue syncing.
sync_err_timeout: Bağlantı zaman aşımına uğradı — sunucu zamanında yanıt vermedi.
sync_exit_warning: Eşitleme hâlâ sürüyor. Şimdi çıkmak veri kaybına yol açabilir.
sync_google_drive_hoshi_compat: Share progress with Hoshi / ッツ
sync_google_drive_hoshi_compat_desc: Sync reading progress via a shared Google Drive folder (ttu-reader-data). Needs full Drive access and re-sign-in.
sync_lan_scan_failed: Tarama başarısız — ağ izinlerini veya güvenlik duvarını kontrol edin.
sync_local_audio_warning: Yerel ses kaynağı veritabanlarını eşitler (büyük olabilir)
sync_now_hint: Bulutla tam iki yönlü eşitlemeyi şimdi çalıştır
sync_pair_confirm_identity_body: You are pairing with $device. Confirm this is the device you expect before continuing.
sync_pair_enter_pin_body: Enter the 6-digit PIN shown on the other device.
sync_pair_fingerprint_changed: Certificate changed — pairing aborted for safety (possible interception).
sync_pair_not_hibiki: No Hibiki device found at this address. The address was saved.
sync_pair_pin_label: Enter this PIN on the other device
sync_pair_pin_waiting: Waiting for the other device to enter this PIN…
sync_pair_request_body: Bir cihaz eşleştirme talep ediyor. Bu cihazla eşitlemesine izin verilsin mi?
sync_pair_unavailable: Diğer cihaz hazır değil veya eski bir sürümde. Güncelleyin ve eşitlemeyi etkinleştirin, ardından tekrar deneyin.
sync_role_locked_by_client: Zaten başka bir cihaza bağlı. Sunucu olarak barındırmadan önce bağlantıyı kaldırın.
sync_role_locked_by_server: Bu cihaz sunucu olarak barındırıyor. Diğer cihazlara bağlanmadan önce sunucuyu kapatın.
sync_section_host_server_footer: Diğer cihazların bu cihazdan eşitlemesine izin verin. Yukarıdaki eşitleme arka ucundan bağımsızdır.
sync_server_mode_clients_drive: Eşitlemeyi bağlı istemciler başlatır — burada elle eşitleme gerekmez.
sync_server_port_in_use: $port bağlantı noktası zaten kullanımda — farklı bir bağlantı noktası seçin.
sync_server_tls_repair_hint: Changing this requires paired devices to pair again
sync_show_remote_entries_warning: Show books and videos that exist on paired devices or the cloud as placeholder cards you can download or stream.
sync_summary: Bulut, LAN P2P ve yerel yedek
sync_video_files_warning: Video files can be very large.
tag_already_on_collection: Tag $name is already on this collection.
tag_name_duplicate: Bu isimde bir etiket zaten mevcut.
tag_no_tags_hint: Henüz etiket yok. Başlamak için bir tane oluşturun.
texthooker_enabled_hint: Textractor/mpv/agent'a bağlanın ve gelen metni arayın
texthooker_experimental_banner: Texthooker deneysel bir özelliktir — canlı metin, arama ve kart oluşturma kararsız olabilir.
theme_seed_preview_hint: Aşağıdaki örnekler, tohum renginizden gerçekte üretilen renkleri önizler. Belirli bir rengi birincil vurgu olarak zorlamak için Birincil anahtarını açıp rengi açıkça seçin.
torrent_upload_intro_body: Uploading (seeding) is off by default. Turn it on to share downloaded content back to the swarm — this uses your upload bandwidth. You can change this anytime in Settings.
ttu_merge_image_pages_subtitle: Standalone single-image chapters render inline in the adjacent text chapter instead of on their own page
ttu_not_bound_cannot_rematch: Sesli kitap bir kitaba bağlı değil, yeniden eşleştirme yapılamaz
update_custom_proxy_auto_hint: Leave blank to use environment variables, then the enabled system proxy.
update_debug_channel_warning: Hata ayıklama kanalı sürümleri kararsız olabilir. Riski size aittir.
update_install_incomplete_message: Yükleyici başladı, ancak Hibiki hâlâ önceki sürümde. Aşağıdaki yükleyici günlüğünü kontrol edin.
update_install_launch_failed_message: Hibiki, $version sürümünün yükleyicisini başlatamadı. Aşağıdaki günlük yolunu kontrol edin.
update_install_log_not_observed: Başlatma sonrası kontrol sırasında yükleyici günlüğü oluşturulmadı.
update_install_log_observed: Başlatma sonrası kontrol sırasında yükleyici günlüğü oluşturuldu.
update_install_manual_close_retry: Listelenen PID/yoldan Hibiki'yi kapatın, ardından güncellemeyi tekrar deneyin ya da yükleyiciyi yeniden çalıştırın.
update_install_parent_exit_not_observed: Güncelleme başlatıcısı, yükleyici başlatılmadan önce Hibiki'nin kapandığını gözlemleyemedi.
update_install_parent_exit_observed: Yükleyici başlatılmadan önce Hibiki'nin kapandığı doğrulandı.
update_install_permission_message: Please allow Hibiki to install apps in system settings, then retry.
update_install_restart_windows_hint: Listelenen süreçler kapatıldığı hâlde libmpv-2.dll hâlâ kilitliyse Windows'u yeniden başlatıp tekrar yükleyin.
update_mac_install_incomplete_message: The update could not be applied, so Hibiki is still on the previous version. You can retry the update, or download the latest release manually.
video_clip_export_remote_download_requir: Bir kesit dışa aktarmadan önce uzak videoyu bu cihaza indirin
video_clip_export_source_changed: Video kaynağı değişti; kesit dışa aktarma iptal edildi
video_control_customize_hint: Her düğmenin oynatıcıda nerede duracağını seçin ya da dışarı taşıyın.
video_control_palette_hint: Eklemek için bir düğmeyi bir yuvaya sürükleyin; bir düğme birden çok yuvada bulunabilir.
video_danmaku_manual_bind_empty: No danmaku for this episode yet.
video_danmaku_manual_bind_failed: Couldn't load danmaku for this episode. Try again later.
video_danmaku_manual_bind_server_error: The danmaku server rejected the request. Try again later.
video_danmaku_manual_network_error: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
video_danmaku_manual_search_prompt: Search Dandanplay by anime title, then pick an episode.
video_delete_confirm: 『$title』 silinsin mi? Bu işlem geri alınamaz.
video_drop_audio_unsupported: Altyazı dosyalarını geçerli videonun üzerine bırakın. Ses dosyaları buraya eklenemez.
video_drop_subtitle_only: Altyazı dosyalarını geçerli videonun üzerine bırakın.
video_file_error_content: Video dosyası yüklenemiyor. Bu dosyanın var olduğundan ve uygulama tarafından erişilebilir bir konumda olduğundan emin olun.
video_import_stream_url_hint: Play HLS/m3u8/mp4 stream URL (with optional external subtitle URL and anti-leech Referer/User-Agent)
video_import_subtitle_optional: İsteğe bağlı dış altyazı (oynatma sırasında gömülü/dış altyazılar arasında istediğiniz zaman geçiş yapabilirsiniz)
video_jimaku_api_key_hint: jimaku.cc/account adresinden ücretsiz API key alın
video_jimaku_source_hint: Choose one Jimaku entry. Season packs are matched by episode automatically.
video_load_failed_network: Network error - check your connection and try again.
video_load_failed_not_found: This item was not found in your library.
video_load_failed_timeout: Connection timed out - the network is slow or the source is rate-limiting. Please try again.
video_load_failed_unavailable: Couldn't get the video stream - it may be unavailable, region or age restricted, or the source changed.
video_mining_image_mode_hint: How covers on video cards are captured
video_quality_empty: No switchable quality for this video
video_quality_enhancement_hint: Görüntüyü mpv'nin yerleşik yüksek kaliteli ölçeklemesiyle keskinleştirmek için bunu açın. Hem anime hem de gerçek çekim dizi ve filmlerde çalışır. Anime4K gibi shader'larla daha ileri gitmek için bir video oynarken Görüntü iyileştirme'yi açın ve oradan bir seviye seçin.
video_quality_load_failed: Couldn't load qualities for this video.
video_render_skia_fix_confirm_body: This disables the Impeller renderer and restarts the app to apply.
video_render_skia_fix_hint: Use if audio plays but the video stays black. Disables Impeller; restarts to apply.
video_resource_missing_message: The file for 『$title』 could not be found. Its location may have changed, or the drive may not be connected. You can re-import it, or remove this entry.
video_scrape_apply_to_collection: Also apply to all $n episodes in this collection
video_scrape_info_empty: No series info yet. It is fetched automatically in the background; you can also match it manually.
video_setting_auto_scrape_hint: Silently fetch cover, synopsis, rating and tags from Bangumi for videos in your library
video_setting_av_delay_hint: Pozitif = altyazı daha geç (satırlar geriye kaydırılır); negatif = altyazı daha erken. Kaydırıcıyı, +/- düğmelerini kullanın ya da bir değer girin.
video_setting_danmaku_area_hint: Fraction of the screen height danmaku may occupy, from the top.
video_setting_danmaku_block_rules_hint: One rule per line. Wrap a line in slashes like /pattern/ for a regular expression; otherwise it matches as case-insensitive text.
video_setting_danmaku_enabled_hint: Yerel veya eşleşen danmaku'yu denetimleri engellemeden videonun üzerinde işle.
video_setting_danmaku_manual_match_hint: Search Dandanplay by title and pick the episode when auto match fails or is wrong.
video_setting_danmaku_max_active_hint: Büyük dosyaların akıcı kalması için kare başına işlenen yorum sayısını sınırlar.
video_setting_danmaku_online_hint: Kullanılabilir bir yerel sidecar yoksa açılan videoyu Dandanplay ile eşleştir ve ilgili yorumları getir.
video_setting_danmaku_speed_hint: Higher is faster; scrolling danmaku cross the screen sooner.
video_setting_double_tap_hint: Sarmak için videonun soluna veya sağına çift dokunun
video_setting_immersive_mode_hint: Yan kilit düğmesine basıldıktan sonra hangi işlevlerin kullanılabilir kalacağını denetler
video_setting_long_press_speed_hint: Videoya basılı tutarken geçici olarak bu hızı kullan.
video_setting_mpv_raw: Ek mpv seçenekleri (her satıra bir tane, key=value)
video_setting_mpv_raw_hint: Yalnızca masaüstü; çalışma zamanında uygulanamayan seçenekler (ör. vo, profile) yok sayılır. SVP/RIFE harici araçlar gerektirir ve desteklenmez.
video_setting_mpv_sigmoid_hint: Sigmoid-curve upscaling reduces ringing but costs GPU. Off by default for performance; turn on if you want sharper upscaling.
video_setting_qb_category_hint: Downloads pushed by Hibiki get this category; completion tracking only watches it.
video_setting_qb_url_hint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080. Leave empty to disable anime downloading.
video_setting_secondary_subtitle_obscure: Blur or hide the secondary (translation) subtitle
video_setting_subtitle_obscure_hint: Choose how subtitles are obscured for listening practice: off, blurred (hover or tap to reveal), or hidden.
video_setting_subtitle_respect_ass_hint: Use the font, color, and outline built into .ass subtitles when available; turn off to force your appearance settings.
video_setting_torrent_memory_hint: Cap engine memory. 0 = auto (based on device RAM).
video_setting_torrent_seed_ratio_hint: Stop uploading when uploaded/downloaded reaches this. 0 = unlimited.
video_setting_torrent_seed_time_hint: Stop uploading after seeding this long. 0 = unlimited.
video_setting_torrent_upload_enabled_hin: Off by default. Seed back to the swarm after downloading.
video_shader_anime4k_hint: İndirmek için bir hazır ayar seçin. İndirdikten sonra etkinleştirmek için listede işaretleyin. Yalnızca masaüstü.
video_shader_first_use_body: 想让动画画面更清晰，可以进入“画质增强”并点击“下载 Anime4K 推荐着色器”。下载后在已安装列表里勾选即可启用。
video_shader_first_use_title: 试试 Anime4K 画质增强
video_shader_import_from_mpv_hint: 自动搜索本机 mpv；未找到时可手动选择 mpv 目录。
video_shader_mobile_perf_hint: Telefonlarda shader'lar yalnızca standart GPU işleme yolunda uygulanır ve etkinlik cihaz GPU'suna göre değişir; yüksek seviyeler kare düşürebilir veya ısınmaya yol açabilir. Önce Düşük/Orta deneyin ve sonucu kendi cihazınızda kontrol edin.
video_shader_preset_mode_a_fast: Çoğu 1080p anime için. Daha düşük GPU yükü.
video_shader_preset_mode_a_hq: 1080p anime için en yüksek kalite. Güçlü bir GPU gerektirir.
video_shader_preset_mode_b_fast: Yeniden örnekleme artefaktlı eski 720p anime için.
video_shader_preset_mode_b_hq: Yeniden örnekleme artefaktlı eski 720p anime için yüksek kalite. Güçlü bir GPU gerektirir.
video_shader_preset_mode_c_fast: Sıkıştırma bulanıklığı olan eski SD (480p) anime için.
video_shader_preset_mode_c_hq: Sıkıştırma bulanıklığı olan eski SD (480p) anime için yüksek kalite. Güçlü bir GPU gerektirir.
video_shader_tier_custom_hint: Özel shader seçimi. Bir hazır ayara geçmek için yukarıdan bir seviye seçin.
video_shader_tier_high_hint: Anime4K HQ. Daha keskin; anime için en iyi, gerçek çekimde de kullanılabilir (daha az kazanç). Üst-orta seviye bir GPU gerektirir (NVIDIA RTX 4060 / RTX 3070, AMD RX 6700 XT / RX 7700 XT).
video_shader_tier_low_hint: mpv yerleşik keskinleştirme (ewa_lanczossharp). Her videoda çalışır (anime ve gerçek çekim). İndirme yok, en düşük GPU yükü. Tümleşik veya eski kartlarda (NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD RX 560, Intel iGPU) bunu seçin.
video_shader_tier_medium_hint: Anime4K Fast. Anime için en iyi, ancak gerçek çekim film/dizilerde de çalışır (daha az kazanç). Orta seviye GPU'larda çalışır (NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 3050, AMD RX 6600).
video_shader_tier_off_hint: İyileştirme yok. Videoyu olduğu gibi oynatır.
video_shader_tier_ultra_hint: Anime4K Mode A (UL, ultra büyük ağ). En güçlü Anime4K yeniden yapılandırması; gerçek çekimde de kullanılabilir (daha az kazanç). Amiral gemisi bir GPU gerektirir (NVIDIA RTX 4080 / RTX 5090, AMD RX 7900 XTX). GPU'nuz daha zayıfsa daha düşük bir seviye seçin.
video_subtitle_attach_playlist_hint: Bölüm başına altyazı eklemek için oynatma listesini açın
video_subtitle_auto_align_low_confidence: Güvenle otomatik hizalanamadı (net bir ses eşleşmesi bulunamadı)
video_subtitle_color_note: Altyazı renkleri video oynatıcı içinde ayarlanır.
video_subtitle_graphic_hint: Grafik altyazı · videoda gösterilir · sözcük araması yok
video_subtitle_graphic_shown: Grafik altyazı videoda gösteriliyor (sözcük araması yok): $label
video_subtitle_load_failed: Bu altyazı yüklenemedi (grafik veya desteklenmeyen iz): $label
video_subtitle_waveform_open_hint: Tap to zoom in and align
video_subtitle_waveform_scroll_hint: Drag to scan the timeline; use the controls below to align
video_subtitle_youtube_empty: This caption track has no text
video_windows_black_flash_notice_body: On Windows, video may flash black under heavy GPU load. To reduce the load, try turning off Quality enhancement, Sigmoid upscaling and Debanding above, or switch Hardware decoding to Copy.
yomitan_api_server_hint: yomitan-api istemcilerinin Hibiki sözlüklerini sorgulamasına izin ver (port 19633)
yomitan_port_kill_confirm_message: The port is currently used by: $process
yomitan_port_kill_failed: Could not end $process. Please end it manually, then retry.
yomitan_port_kill_protected: $process is a critical system process — Hibiki will not end it. Change the port instead.
yomitan_port_kill_self_instance: This process is another running instance of this app.
game_line_audio_overlong_hint: Far longer than a single line; may include BGM or other mixed audio
game_line_tracks_hint: Preview each track at this line's moment, then exclude the BGM ones
anki_lapis_font_scale_hint: Scales every Lapis font size; takes effect via "Apply style to Anki".
anki_lapis_custom_css_hint: Appended to the Lapis stylesheet in a protected user section.
anki_lapis_apply_done: Lapis style applied. A backup was saved first.
anki_lapis_up_to_date: Lapis style is already up to date.
anki_lapis_foreign_edit_body: The Lapis template in Anki differs from what Hibiki last applied - it may have been edited by hand. Applying will overwrite it; a backup is saved first. Continue?
anki_lapis_not_found: Lapis note type not found in Anki.
anki_lapis_restore_confirm: Overwrite the Lapis template in Anki with this backup? The current state is backed up first.
anki_dedup_report_body: $groups duplicate groups; $removed extra copies ($size); $notes notes and $models note types rewritten; $skipped skipped.
anki_dedup_unavailable: Requires Anki running on this machine (AnkiConnect).
anki_dedup_run_hint: Scans first and lists exactly what would be deleted; nothing is removed until you confirm.
anki_dedup_plan_intro: $count extra copies, $size reclaimable. One copy of each file is kept and every reference is repointed to it first; nothing is ever re-encoded.
anki_dedup_plan_journal: A journal of every rewrite and deletion is written to the backup folder first.
manga_google_lens_privacy: Google Lens uses an unofficial Chromium endpoint. Pages are uploaded only when you explicitly select Lens; Automatic mode never uploads them.
manga_google_lens_disclosure_title: Send manga pages to Google Lens?
manga_google_lens_disclosure_body: Recognizing this manga sends a reduced JPEG copy of each page without OCR text to Google. Results are cached on this device. The endpoint is unofficial and may stop working. Nothing is uploaded unless you agree.
game_scrape_search_failed: Search failed. Check your network and try again.
game_remove_confirm: Remove this game from the library? Game files on disk will not be deleted.
manga_ocr_acceleration_degraded: GPU acceleration unavailable, running OCR on ${engine}: ${reason}
download_rate_limit_lan_exempt: Does not apply within your local network; LAN transfers always run at full speed.
video_scrape_search_failed: Search failed. Tap Search to retry.
scrape_reason_network: Could not get a valid response from the cover source. Check your network and retry.
scrape_reason_server: The cover source returned an error. Try again later or pick another candidate.
collection_already_has_item: This item is already in the collection.
drag_drop_manga_archive_unsupported: Can't import .cbr/.rar comic archives — repack as .cbz or a folder of images.
collection_add_failed: Couldn't add the item to the collection. Please try again.
anki_dedup_auto_hint: Off by default. When on, Hibiki scans at startup (at most once a week) and shows you the list first — nothing is deleted until you confirm.
anki_dedup_auto_delete_hint: Skips the confirmation dialog. Only byte-identical extra copies are ever removed and nothing is re-encoded, but deletion cannot be undone.
anki_dedup_auto_found: Found $count duplicate Anki media files ($size reclaimable)
anki_dedup_auto_done: Removed $count duplicate Anki media files, $size reclaimed
anki_lapis_backup_done_pruned: Backed up to $path ($count old backups pruned by the 90-day / keep-10 policy)
game_audio_fallback_full_hint: Falls back to the system mix when no clean voice is captured; the clip may contain BGM and effects.
game_audio_fallback_clean_hint: Uses game resource audio and engine PCM only. Lines with no voice are mined without audio instead of picking up BGM.
game_audio_fallback_resource_hint: Requires the original voice file shipped with the game; mining is refused when it is missing.
game_line_audio_suppressed_hint: No clean audio source produced audio for this line, and the system mix was skipped by your audio fallback policy. This does not mean the line has no voice.
video_setting_torrent_limit_lan_hint: Off by default: transfers with peers on your local network ignore the limits above.
download_rate_limit_lan_included: Also applies within your local network.
video_collection_no_local_member: No local video in this collection
gal_mining_image_mode_hint: Galgame scenes barely move within one line, so a still screenshot is usually smaller and just as useful.
video_setting_jimaku_default_language_hi: Preferred language when the series has no remembered choice
video_jimaku_api_key_settings_hint: Also editable in Settings → Video → Subtitles
anime_download_subs_episodes_unverified: Episode numbers are not verified against this pack - subtitles may come from another season.
anime_download_subs_deferred: Subtitles are matched after download, from the pack's actual files
anime_download_subs_unmatched: Subtitles: no match for this pack
download_backend_desktop_only_note: Built-in engine requires a desktop platform. This device uses external qBittorrent.
anime_download_subs_season_mismatch: No subtitle entry matches season $season of this pack - not auto-selected. Pick one manually if you want it anyway.
media_tracking_not_connected: Not connected. Progress stays local and nothing reaches Bangumi.
media_tracking_unauthorized: Bangumi rejected the access token. Reconnect it in settings.
media_tracking_unlinked_hint: No item is linked to a Bangumi subject yet, so finishing something changes nothing there. Automatic matching only links a subject when the title matches unambiguously; link the rest by hand.
game_hook_reason_protocol_mismatch: The capture helper version does not match Hibiki. Update or reinstall the galgame capture helper.
game_upscaling_auto_hint: Use Magpie if present, otherwise download our build (about 10 MB) after asking.
game_upscaling_installed_only_hint: Only use a Magpie that is already installed. Never downloads anything.
game_helper_bundle_missing: The galgame hook helper is not bundled with this build. Update Hibiki to get it.
game_upscaling_pick_body: Upscales this game window with Magpie while a capture session is running. Set per game - it only helps for games whose native resolution is lower than your screen. Uses your GPU.
game_upscaling_hint_not_installed: Magpie is not installed. Right-click this game in your library and set window upscaling to Auto to download it.
media_tracking_retry_no_match: No match found. Try manual linking.
stat_clear_all_game_message: Clear all game play time and session counts? Your game library and activity timeline are kept. This cannot be undone.
batch_selection_stale_skipped: Skipped $m of $n selected items that no longer exist
game_text_thread_unset: No thread selected — pick one to start capturing
manga_import_hint: Pick a manga folder, a .cbz/.zip page archive, or a .mokuro file.
manga_import_missing_input: Pick a manga file or folder first.
manga_import_detected_message: "$name" is a manga file, so it will go through the manga importer instead of the book importer.
selection_web_search_unavailable: No app can search the web.
selection_share_failed: Could not open the share sheet.
sync_last_no_channels: Last sync: nothing synced - no connected sync channel
sync_last_auto_disabled: Last sync: skipped - auto sync is off
anime_download_no_results_detail: The service responded successfully but returned 0 items. Query: $query; filters: $filters. Try another title or loosen the filters.
interconnect_enable_footer: How to use: on the device that holds your library, turn on the sync server switch below; on your other device, add the address of that server to pair with it. A device can act as only one role at a time — server or client.
interconnect_peer_list_empty: No peers added yet. Pick a discovered device from the LAN device list below to pair automatically, or add a peer address manually.
